tools.name: browser_drop
tools.description: Drop files or MIME-typed data onto an element, as if dragged from outside the page. At least one of "paths" or "data" must be provided.

parameters.name: element
parameters.description: Human-readable element description used to obtain permission to interact with the element

parameters.name: target
parameters.description: Exact target element reference from the page snapshot, or a unique element selector

parameters.name: paths
parameters.description: Absolute paths to files to drop onto the element.

parameters.name: data
parameters.description: Data to drop, as a map of MIME type to string value (e.g. {"text/plain": "hello", "text/uri-list": "https://example.com"}).

source.name: browser_drop

parameters.name: colorScheme
parameters.description: Emulates the prefers-color-scheme media feature

parameters.name: reducedMotion
parameters.description: Emulates the prefers-reduced-motion media feature

parameters.name: forcedColors
parameters.description: Emulates the forced-colors media feature

parameters.name: contrast
parameters.description: Emulates the prefers-contrast media feature

parameters.name: media
parameters.description: Changes the CSS media type of the page

source.name: browser_emulate_media

tools.name: browser_evaluate
tools.description: Evaluate JavaScript expression on page or element

parameters.name: element
parameters.description: Human-readable element description used to obtain permission to interact with the element

parameters.name: target
parameters.description: Exact target element reference from the page snapshot, or a unique element selector

parameters.name: function
parameters.description: () => { /* code */ } or (element) => { /* code */ } when element is provided

parameters.name: filename
parameters.description: File name to save the result to. Relative file names are resolved against the workspace root. If not provided, result is returned as text.

source.name: browser_evaluate
source.description: Evaluate JavaScript expression on page or element

tools.name: browser_find
tools.description: Search the accessibility snapshot of the current page for text or a regular expression. Returns matching snapshot nodes with a few lines of surrounding context (like search snippets), each shown under its path from the root of the tree, which is cheaper than capturing the whole snapshot when you only need to locate an element and its ref.

parameters.name: text
parameters.description: Plain text to search for in the page snapshot (case-insensitive substring match). Provide either text or regex, not both.

parameters.name: regex
parameters.description: Regular expression to search for in the page snapshot. Matching is case-sensitive by default; wrap the pattern in slashes to add flags, e.g. "/error/i" for case-insensitive. Provide either text or regex, not both.

parameters.name: maxResults
parameters.description: Maximum number of matching items to return. Defaults to returning all matches.

parameters.name: filename
parameters.description: Save results to a file instead of returning them in the response. Relative file names are resolved against the workspace root.

source.name: browser_find

tools.name: browser_network_request
tools.description: Returns full details (headers and body) of a single network request, or a single part if `part` is set. Use the number from browser_network_requests.

parameters.name: index
parameters.description: 1-based index of the request, as printed by browser_network_requests.

parameters.name: part
parameters.description: Return only this part of the request. Omit to return full details.

parameters.name: filename
parameters.description: File name to save the result to. Relative file names are resolved against the workspace root. If not provided, output is returned as text.

source.name: browser_network_request
source.description: Returns full details (headers and body) of a single network request, or a single part if `part` is set. Use the number from browser_network_requests.

tools.name: browser_network_requests
tools.description: Returns a numbered list of network requests since loading the page. Use browser_network_request with the number to get full details.

parameters.name: static
parameters.description: Whether to include successful static resources like images, fonts, scripts, etc. Defaults to false.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Only return requests whose URL matches this regexp (e.g. "/api/.*user").

parameters.name: all
parameters.description: Return all network requests since the beginning of the session, not just since the last navigation. Defaults to false.

parameters.name: filename
parameters.description: File name to save the network requests to. Relative file names are resolved against the workspace root. If not provided, requests are returned as text.

source.name: browser_network_requests
source.description: Returns a numbered list of network requests since loading the page. Use browser_network_request with the number to get full details.

tools.name: browser_run_code_unsafe
tools.description: Run a Playwright code snippet. Unsafe: executes arbitrary JavaScript in the Playwright server process and is RCE-equivalent.

parameters.name: code
parameters.description: A JavaScript function containing Playwright code to execute. It will be invoked with a single argument, page, which you can use for any page interaction. For example: `async (page) => { await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Submit' }).click(); return await page.title(); }`

parameters.name: filename
parameters.description: Load code from the specified file. Relative file names are resolved against the workspace root. If both code and filename are provided, code will be ignored.

source.name: browser_run_code_unsafe
source.description: Run a Playwright code snippet. Unsafe: executes arbitrary JavaScript in the Playwright server process and is RCE-equivalent.

tools.name: browser_snapshot
tools.description: Capture accessibility snapshot of the current page, this is better than screenshot

parameters.name: target
parameters.description: Exact target element reference from the page snapshot, or a unique element selector

parameters.name: filename
parameters.description: Save snapshot to a file instead of returning it in the response. Relative file names are resolved against the workspace root.

parameters.name: depth
parameters.description: Limit the depth of the snapshot tree

parameters.name: boxes
parameters.description: Include each element's bounding box as [box=x,y,width,height] in the snapshot. Coordinates are viewport-relative, in CSS pixels (Element.getBoundingClientRect)

source.name: browser_snapshot
source.description: Capture accessibility snapshot of the current page, this is better than screenshot

tools.name: browser_take_screenshot
tools.description: Take a screenshot of the current page. Use browser_snapshot for actions by default. With the vision capability enabled, use screenshot coordinates with the coordinate-based mouse tools for elements not exposed in the accessibility snapshot.

parameters.name: element
parameters.description: Human-readable element description used to obtain permission to interact with the element

parameters.name: target
parameters.description: Exact target element reference from the page snapshot, or a unique element selector

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Image format for the screenshot. If unset, inferred from the filename extension, otherwise png.

parameters.name: filename
parameters.description: File name to save the screenshot to. Relative file names are resolved against the workspace root. If not specified, the screenshot is saved into the output directory as `page-{timestamp}.{png|jpeg|webp}`.

parameters.name: fullPage
parameters.description: When true, takes a screenshot of the full scrollable page, instead of the currently visible viewport. Cannot be used with element screenshots.

parameters.name: scale
parameters.description: Image resolution scale. "css" produces a screenshot sized in CSS pixels (smaller, consistent across devices). "device" produces a high-resolution screenshot using device pixels (larger, accounts for the device pixel ratio). Default is css.

source.name: browser_take_screenshot
source.description: Take a screenshot of the current page. Use browser_snapshot for actions by default. With the vision capability enabled, use screenshot coordinates with the coordinate-based mouse tools for elements not exposed in the accessibility snapshot.

tools.name: browser_wait_for
tools.description: Wait for text to appear or disappear or a specified time to pass. When both text and textGone are provided, waits for the first one to happen

parameters.name: time
parameters.description: The time to wait in seconds, at most 30. When combined with text or textGone, serves as a timeout for them instead of the default action timeout

parameters.name: text
parameters.description: The text to wait for

parameters.name: textGone
parameters.description: The text to wait for to disappear

source.name: browser_wait_for
source.description: Wait for text to appear or disappear or a specified time to pass. When both text and textGone are provided, waits for the first one to happen

tools.name: browser_tabs
tools.description: List, create, close, or select a browser tab.

parameters.name: action
parameters.description: Operation to perform

parameters.name: index
parameters.description: Tab index, used for close/select. If omitted for close, current tab is closed.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: URL to navigate to in the new tab, used for new.

parameters.name: isolatedContext
parameters.description: Name of an isolated browser context to create the new tab in, used for new. Tabs in the same isolated context share cookies and storage, tabs in different contexts are fully isolated. If omitted or "default", the tab is created in the default context.

source.name: browser_tabs
source.description: List, create, close, or select a browser tab.
